```plato

//==
// # Time-varying field interfaces
//
// Fields whose values evolve over a timeline. The time argument is an Instant
// on the animation or simulation timeline.

// A planar scalar field that changes over time: animated masks, ripples,
// and evolving density maps.
interface ITimeVaryingScalarField2D
{
    EvalAtTime(x: Self, point: Point2D, time: Instant): Number;
}

// A spatial scalar field that changes over time: simulation densities,
// temperatures, and animated implicit shapes.
interface ITimeVaryingScalarField3D
{
    EvalAtTime(x: Self, point: Point3D, time: Instant): Number;
}

// A planar vector field that changes over time: 2D flows and animated
// displacement maps.
interface ITimeVaryingVectorField2D
{
    EvalAtTime(x: Self, point: Point2D, time: Instant): Vector2D;
}

// A spatial vector field that changes over time: velocity fields of fluids,
// wind, and turbulence used for advection.
interface ITimeVaryingVectorField3D
{
    EvalAtTime(x: Self, point: Point3D, time: Instant): Vector3D;
}
```
